first_page_lines: CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report

Topic                 Item    Checklist item description                                                                                                                                       Reported on Line
Title                  1     The diagnosis or intervention of primary focus followed by the words “case report” . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines1-3, Page1
Key Words              2      2 to 5 key words that identify diagnoses or interventions in this case report, including "case report" . . . Lines23-25, Page1
Abstract              3a     Introduction: What is unique about this case and what does it add to the scientific literature? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines195-198, Page7

(no references)       3b     Main symptoms and/or important clinical findings . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines81-82, Page3
3c     The main diagnoses, therapeutic interventions, and outcomes . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines116-126, Page4-5
3d     Conclusion—What is the main “take-away” lesson(s) from this case? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines42-47, Page2
Introduction           4     One or two paragraphs summarizing why this case is unique (may include references) . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines161-187, Page6-7
Patient Information   5a     De-identified patient specific information. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines80-81, Page3
5b     Primary concerns and symptoms of the patient. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines81-82, Page3
5c     Medical, family, and psycho-social history including relevant genetic information . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines86-88, Page3-4
5d     Relevant past interventions with outcomes . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Not Applicable
Clinical Findings      6     Describe significant physical examination (PE) and important clinical findings. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines82-86, Page3
Timeline               7     Historical and current information from this episode of care organized as a timeline . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Fig.4
Diagnostic            8a     Diagnostic testing (such as PE, laboratory testing, imaging, surveys). . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines89-116, Page4
Assessment
8b     Diagnostic challenges (such as access to testing, financial, or cultural) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines161-168, Page6
8c     Diagnosis (including other diagnoses considered) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines130-137, Page5
8d     Prognosis (such as staging in oncology) where applicable . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Not Applicable
Therapeutic           9a     Types of therapeutic intervention (such as pharmacologic, surgical, preventive, self-care) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines117-119, Page4
Intervention          9b     Administration of therapeutic intervention (such as dosage, strength, duration) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines117-119, Page4
9c     Changes in therapeutic intervention (with rationale) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Lines119-120, Page4-5
